name: cdm/base/datetime/AdjustableOrRelativeDate
description: A class giving the choice between defining a date as an explicit date together with applicable adjustments or as relative to some other (anchor) date.

adjustableDate.description: A date that shall be subject to adjustment if it would otherwise fall on a day that is not a business day in the specified business centers, together with the convention for adjusting the date.

relativeDate.description: A date specified as some offset to another date (the anchor date).
